newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Shares in Ericsson jump on mobile phone forecast.
newsitem.headline: Shares in Ericsson jump on mobile phone forecast.

text.p: Shares in Swedish telecoms group Ericsson jumped on Friday on a newspaper report saying the company expected to sell 50 million mobile phones in 2000 in a total market of up to 300 million phones.
At 1245 GMT, the share was up four crowns at 272 on the Stockholm Stock Exchange, while the bourse's general index was 0.28 percent higher at 2,808.05.
"It's the article (in daily) Dagens Industri that is pushing the share upwards and we see several U.S. investors buying," a trader said.
Another trader said the share broke a technical resistance level at 271 crowns and saw a short term potential in the share price at 277 crowns.
An analyst said he appreciated the stronger mobile phone sales forecast but was uncertain if the news was correct.
"If the forecast of 50 million mobile phones is correct it means that you might have to revalue the entire company, but this is hard to judge," an analyst said.
"I think the share is fully valued at 280 crowns," he said, adding that other brokerages had a target price of 300 crowns a share.
